image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a guenon monkey perched on a tree branch. The monkey has dark fur on its back and head, transitioning to golden-orange fur on its underside and limbs. It features a distinctive facial ruff of long hair framing a bare face with forward-facing eyes. One hand is visible gripping the branch, showing distinct fingers. The background is a soft-focus green forest environment.
